source.name: GIE AGSI+ (Aggregated Gas Storage Inventory)
source.note: Gas Infrastructure Europe transparency platform; data published daily ~18:00 CET for the previous gas day, recent days are revised.

targets.text: EU rule: each member state's storage should reach 90% at any point between 1 October and 1 December (Regulation (EU) 2017/1938 Art. 6a as amended by Regulation (EU) 2025/1733, applies to 2027). Up to 10 percentage points lower is allowed in difficult market conditions; intermediate targets (1 Feb, 1 May, 1 Jul, 1 Sep) are set per country and are indicative unless that country decides otherwise.

notes.GB: United Kingdom: AGSI+ has UK data only up to 30 Dec 2020 (pre-Brexit), so it is not shown.
notes.IE: Ireland: no storage data reported in AGSI+.
notes.UA: Ukraine is not an EU member: shown for reference, not part of the EU total.
